posts.title: The 80% Problem: The Last 20% Is Where the Engineer Used to Live
posts.description: AI gets you to a working draft fast. The trouble is what the missing fifth contains, the edge cases and operational reality that used to teach engineers their judgment, and who builds that muscle now.

posts.title: AI Is the Ultimate Leaky Abstraction
posts.description: A generated answer is an abstraction over reasoning you never see. It works until it leaks, and when it leaks it hands you a bill for exactly the understanding it let you skip.

posts.title: Why More Cores Stopped Saving Us
posts.description: Adding cores quietly stopped working, and Amdahl told us why forty years early: scaling stalls on the one dependency you can't parallelize away, not the resource you keep buying.
